from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money


def process_refund_request(payment, amount, requested_by, at):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent."""
    amount = round_money(to_money(amount))
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":

    refunded = to_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > to_money(payment.amount):

            f"{refunded + amount} > {payment.amount}",

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount

        amount=float(amount),
        refunded_amount=float(payment.refunded_amount),
